file: File:The oldest writing in the world - The Sumerian Stone Tablet.jpg
artist: editorship by Prof. Charles F. Horne
description:
A Sumerian Stone Tablet containing a Locust Charm; unknown origin (p. 30). It was labelled in a 1907 book as "the oldest writing in the world".


The tablet records the means taken to rid various tracts of the land of a plague of locust and caterpillars. The last line, "he made it bright," refers to the ceremonial purification of the field.
